caveats: Day-of-year is the fixed leap-year numbering (function of month/day: 29 Feb = 60, 31 Dec = 366; non-leap years have no day 60). Threshold/climatology pools include the specified 5-day window extensions beyond the 1992-2002 baseline (1991-12-27..1991-12-31, 2003-01-01..2003-01-05); day 60 has no pool and is set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing. Per-cell MHWs and joins were computed only within 2016-06-01..2016-08-31, so an event ongoing at a period edge is truncated there. Sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days): 3304 of 3600 region cells (296 land); MHW flags are 0 outside sea cells.
